pr_title: expression: introduce `StaticEvalContext` to provide context when evaluating expressions
pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #52630

### What changed and how does it work?

- Move the definition of `SQLWarn` to `pkg/util/context`. Add added some methods to `WarnHandler`. The old interface is renamed to `WarnAppender`.
- Introduce `StaticWarnHandler` to provide a thread-safe implementation.
- Introduce `StaticEvalContext` to  provide a static implementation of `EvalContext`. We also provides a function `NewStaticEvalContext` to create a new instance. For example:

```
// create a context with specified timezone and type flags.
ctx = NewStaticEvalContext(
    WithLocation(time.Local),
    WithTypeFlags(types.FlagAllowNegativeToUnsigned|types.FlagSkipASCIICheck),
    // ....
)
```

```release-note
None
```

issue_context.title: introduce `StaticEvalContext` to provide context when evaluating expressions

review_comments: Can you give some explaination about why the `staticEvalCtxState` is named by `static`?
This and "NewStaticWarnHandlerWithHandler" seems to be no use. Is there any other PR that will use them later?

These methods is going to be used in two scenes:

1. replace `mock.Context` to do some tests or evaluate expressions in production code.
2. "Clone" a `SessionEvalContext` for cursor fetch.
